motifs.semantics: weakly connected vertex-induced directed multigraph; each vertex subset counted once; loops and isolates retained
motifs.unsupported: count excluded connected subsets explicitly; never clip multiplicity

structural_fixtures.relabeling: every permutation of each fixture's vertices
structural_fixtures.oracle: independent exact isomorphism against all labeled motif templates

survival_fixtures.oracle: exact Fraction-weighted enumeration of every labelled edge-choice history
survival_fixtures.extinction: requested event horizon beyond exhaustion is unavailable, not padded

null_fixtures.oracle: enumerate ordered endpoint assignments with the same in/out degree sequences; compare exact score distributions to target-permutation null

gate_cases: one synthetic qualifying record and one failure for each required condition; unknown or missing fields fail closed
acceptance: Exact structural counts, relabelings, rational probabilities, null distributions, and synthetic effect/gate outcomes all match; no statistical tolerance or tuning
next: R03 needs a separately registered feasible run matrix and launch; this calibration does not launch it
